newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Optus spends A$7 bln on Australia network.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Optus spends A$7 bln on Australia network.

text.p: Optus Communications Pty Ltd said on Wednesday it had invested more than A$7 billion on the development of the nation's second telecommunications network, with 75 percent of the funds spent in Australia.
The company also said in a statement outlining its 1995/96 industry development report that its workforce grew by 18 percent in the year to 4,186.
Optus, which competes with the state-owned Telstra Corp, said it had spent A$2.7 billion on capital expenditure, with A$2 billion allocated to local industry.
Optus Communications is 25 percent owned by Mayne Nickless Ltd and 24.5 percent each by BellSouth Corp and Cable and Wireless Plc.
The telecoms carrier also owns 46.5 percent of local pay television operator Optus Vision, which is embroiled in legal action with minority owner Seven Network Ltd.
This legal action prevented Optus Communications from proceeding with a share market listing this calendar year, but it still plans to float on the Australian Stock Exchange.
